notes.title: Alpha Update 4.7
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

News:[list]
[*] new campfire crafting system. Usage is very simple. From now it works in a similar way as hand craft. From the available list on the left side choose what dish you want to cook. To campfire add required tools and fuel. Then select the prepare button and wait until the dish is ready;
[*] new stuff - Workbench. Works in exactly the same way as the campfire. On it we can prepare more specialized stuff which will require additional work space and you won't be able to prepare them in your hand.
[/list]

Changes:[list]
[*] large changes in the UI menu crafting. From now more convenient and clear;
[*] anvil. Now we can put him on the ground and then (the same like a campfie or workbench) choose available items and start crafting.
[/list]

Therefore with the above changes some items that could prepared in hand have been moved to anvil or workbench.

In the next update we will focus only on updating old items and adding new ones.

Stay tuned for next update!

notes.title: Alpha Update 4.6 Christmas Edition
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

many news and changes! Let's see what we have for you.
[list]
[*] Winter & Christmas are came to town! Falling snow, snowdrifts, snowy fields and trees. Snow is everywhere! Also Christmas accents appeared in Allergenium! Santa Claus crashed somewhere the city. Find him and his presents. You can get the Santa's outfit, Christmas t-shirt and stylish sweater!

[*] New UI look! We changed all. Now it's bigger and more clearly. Information about level and skill point you can find on the left site on the view. Bigger inventory and item info on the right side and ofcourse crafting.

[*] New search item. From now you can search items in other places, like a bookshelf, junk pile, locker, drawer.

[*] New item: Tent. Is like a sleeping bag and chest in one!

[*] New easy craft for sleeping bag (use wheat straw and leather only).

[*] New Sounds effects: snow footstep, splash on ocean, when you search (the car, lockers, shelfbook, open door, drink jar), use (flashlight, can) and pickup (tent, leather, nails, electornics, tape, battery, recipe, schematic).

[*] New info system. Now you will get a notification (pop-up window) about the approaching zombie brute, and falling allergy, and about the full inventory as in the case of information on advancing to the next level.

[*] Added the free hand Q to shortucut icon.

[*] Reduced search time of some items and vehicles.

[*] The ocean has been a little bit optimized.

[*] Look of the inventory has changed and got more space. Now has a 60 slots. To unlock an additional 28 slots you will need to gain another level and complete tasks (this option will be available later).

[*] Changed spawn starting point. For winter time, spawn is now closer to the city!

[*] Bugs: Interios green house have some mesh blocking.
[/list]
Enjoy and have fun with Christmas event! Happy Holidays to everyone survivors!

notes.title: Alpha Update 4.5 Halloween Edition
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

today we have for you some news and events. First of all in 26th October Allergenium had a birthday! Yes, the first year is behind us. Many things we are done, but we known there is still a lot to be done. All time we have really desire and energy and ideas to develop our game. Also on this occasion, we wanted to thank everyone who purchased our game! We hope our community will grow!

Moreover Halloween is coming to Allergenium World! We have a few surprises for you on this occasion, but more details below.

News:[list]
[*] Sounds - new system and environment sounds like a wind, ocean, birds, frogs on pond and crickets on the night. Now the game is more climatic.
[*] Zombie - new bigger and brutal zombie. He spawn only at night on random places and every few days. He was the result of experiments on zombies. Who is responsible for this? Nobody knows it yet, but when he spawn you can hear a spooky sound. He locates the nearest player and follows him through the entire map. This zombie isn't very intelligent but very strong. It makes no sense to fight him without good equipment, but you can hide from him. For example in a closed room. Also in the morning (about 4 a.m.) the creature dies. 
[*] Skin system - wardrobe is a new equipment in game. From now every found and gained clothes go to separate place. Wardrobe is one for all your characters. So if you gained some nice outfit you can wear it anytime and for all yours characters.
[*] Halloween Event - pumpkin decoration and special outfit only on Halloween Event! Find and smash pumpkins in the whole city to get special gifts. Pumpkin cap and t-shirt are waiting for you!
[*] Birthday Celebrate - celebrate our first birthday with us. Look for a unique t-shirt and cake, completely edible! Buon Appetito!
[/list]

Changes:[list]
[*] Inventory - now inventory have 44 space. That is a 12 more than before, but first you must unlock!
[*] Icons have been added to all hats.
[*] Fix many small bugs.
[/list]

Have fun, enjoy and good luck! :)

notes.title: Alpha Update 4.4
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

sorry for such a long downtime! This month we primarily worked for optimization. Now it should play much better.

News:[list]
[*]  Trees are now bigger, better environment look.
[*] Current world time and days have been added. We will need this information in a future update. In such cases like taking medicine at the same time or defense against zombie horde on a specific day.
[*] New Wall Wood Window.
[/list]

Changes:[list]
[*] Radar was deleted. Instead of that we added new compass, which plays a similar role.
[*] Info about current level and experience was replaced from right to the left side. The right side must be clear for the future mission.
[*] Small cometic changes with HUD player.
[*] Change shadow and fog distance, but still small problem with shadow light.
[*] Change field of view palyer.
[/list]

Bug fixed:[list]
[*]  Free Hand (Q button) not working properly. When player have something else that weapon in hand the Q button wasn't working.
[*] FPS progress (30 or more). Of course still in some places there are drops FPS, mostly on the spawn player, beach and airport. If you see some big droprate, please don't hesitate to write us. We are waiting for your feedback!:)
[/list]

Next update will show in a month and we will focus on ambient sounds and some buildings constructions.

notes.title: Alpha Update 4.2
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

for more interesting gameplay we plan to add some improvements to the game in the near future. In this update we changed the allergy system, but before you read more about it, let's see what else we have prepared for you!  

News:[list]

[*] new zombie - Airport Worker. Spawn only in an airport board;

[*] from now your immunity decreases all the time when you eat or drink something that you have allergy. Until your character are dead. To stop this you should find and take the antybiotics. notes.title: Alpha Update 3.7
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors and welcome to our 1 of 3 updates planned in Q1!

Let's see what we have for you:

- Navigation HUD
We added navigation. It's to help you to easier find your sleeping bag, house, spawn point or gravestone on the map. In story mode additionally they will be marked quests, tasks, tips and NPC's. In the future we are planning add much more different points.

- SleepingBag (bug fixes + changes)
Now when you put on the ground new sleeping bag the previous one are deleted. It helps in navigation HUD. It will be more clearly.

- Story mode
We start work on it. In story mode you can experience an adventure and learn more about the Allergenium world. Dialogues and quest system requires a lot of work and time, so currently status are still in progress.

- Select mode menu
We corrected error which caused incorrect highlighting when we selecting mode.

- Saves (bug fixes + changes)
By adding a new mode saving the environment has been changed. In this version is necessary create a new character when you want to play! 

Earlier not all data were correctly deleted when you removed your character. As a result, the file with save's could have too big weight despite if you removed a characters.

- Balancing player energy
Now you can run much longer. Energy consume is lower.

Stay tuned for next update!

The recipes system has been fully completed. At the moment we created two recipes. You can find them on the map.
The preparation food by yourself gives many benefits. It's a full meal, more nutritious than you would ate all products separatly. Also you get more experience.

New recipes:[list]

When you find one of them your character can learn them. Then you have unlocked a new possibility to crafting and cooking. For now we have made stage 1 of 3. We need more time to finish everything. Also we need to add more different fruits, vegetables and other food products that you will be able to prepare something for consumption.
We added new keyboard shortcut: B - schematics&recipes. There you can see how it looks like.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33508794/05d8d1d1b507405752a29a2b48d6eb7964efee95.png[/img]

[*] leek;
[*] tomato slice;
[*] cucumber slice,
[*] recipes and schematics.
[/list]
Changes:[list]
[*] now you can faster move item to inventory. Just double click on it.
[/list]
Bug fixed:[list]
[*] some cars on higway was broken where the search didn't work at all;
[*] some big cars like a bus, van had problem with search distance and searching progress not working there properly. The circle was appears 
when we were really close the cars. Changed distance;

[*] when you wearing something (hat, backpack) your inventory keeps space for this stuff. You can't take anything else but you can see  free slot;
